record.dic_text:
01713 dagal {daw-gal'}

字根型; TWOT - 402b; 動詞

欽定本 - (set up) banner 3, chiefest 1; 4

1) 看, 觀看
   1a) (Qal) 望著, 引人注目 (分詞) (#歌 5:10|)
2) 扛著旗幟或軍旗, 豎立旗幟或軍旗
   2a) (Qal) 豎立軍旗 (在戰場上) (#詩 20:5|)
   2b) (Niphal) 備有旗幟, 帶著旗幟 (#歌 6:4,10|)
record.edic_text:
01713 dagal {daw-gal'}

a primitive root; TWOT - 402b; v

AV - (set up) banner 3, chiefest 1; 4

1) to look, behold
   1a) (Qal) looked at, conspicuous (participle)
2) to carry a banner or standard, set up banner or standard
   2a) (Qal) to set up standard (in battle)
   2b) (Niphal) supplied with banners, bannered
